sections.title: Advanced Concepts
sections.content: Level 2 focuses on properties and relationships of triangles, circles, and polygons. It includes symmetry, parallel lines, and angle equations.

sections.title: Triangles and Their Types
sections.content: Isosceles, right-angled, scalene triangles. Using Heron's formula to find area. Relationships between sides and angles.

sections.title: Circles and Tangents
sections.content: Circle properties: center, radius, diameter, tangent. Tangent forms a 90° angle with the radius. Formulas for arcs and segments.

sections.title: Polygons and Their Properties
sections.content: Regular polygons, interior and exterior angles, area formulas for polygons.

sections.title: Common Mistakes
sections.content: Calculating triangle area with wrong base/height. Confusing radius and diameter. Errors in polygon angle calculations.

sections.title: Quick Summary
sections.content: Remember properties of triangles, circles, and polygons. Pay attention to tangents and angles. Practice formulas regularly.

tricks.title: Quick Triangle Area
tricks.example: Triangle base = 10 cm, height = 6 cm; area = 10 × 6 ÷ 2 = 30 cm²

tricks.title: Identify Isosceles Triangle
tricks.explanation: Two sides are equal. Height and median coincide.
tricks.example: Sides 5 cm, 5 cm, 8 cm; height = median

tricks.title: Tangent Properties
tricks.example: Radius r = 4 cm; tangent is perpendicular to radius

tricks.title: Heron’s Formula
tricks.explanation: If all sides known: area = √[s(s-a)(s-b)(s-c)], s = (a+b+c)/2

tricks.title: Use Symmetry
tricks.explanation: In symmetric shapes, known sides/angles help calculate the rest quickly.
tricks.example: In a parallelogram, opposite sides are equal
